comments.author: goutham-valugula
comments.text: The report’s isolation is useful in narrowing this down: in `load-class-in-isolation.ts`, the VM receives the host `require`, so package imports still use the host process’s CommonJS resolver state. `DirectoryLoader.unloadAll()` (2.44.7) removes `require.cache` entries under the package roots, but does not clear `Module._pathCache`; the reported deleted `lib/imap-flow.js` path is consistent with stale resolution state surviving that sweep. Since the same error persisted after clearing matching `_pathCache` entries in the earlier probe, that cache alone is not yet a demonstrated fix. A focused regression would be to load a dependency whose `exports`/entry path changes across a same-path package replacement, then verify reload resolves the new path (or explicitly requires a process restart).
